substantive_insights: A practical constraint (rain-facing window + drying rack) creates a hard trade-off between ventilation and protecting laundry, which simple timing promises do not resolve.
Temporal concessions (A agreeing to free stove in 15 minutes) can de-escalate stove-access conflict without resolving the broader ventilation responsibility dispute.

Agent B's eventual physical takeover of the stove resolves immediate exposure to odour for B but risks escalating tension with Agent C because the underlying ventilation action (opening the window) remains blocked by the laundry situation.
